blocks.content: Quiz: What does Object.assign({}, defaults, custom) return when both defaults and custom have a speed property?
Tap an option below to answer:
An object with the speed value from defaults
Later source objects overwrite earlier ones. custom comes after defaults, so its speed wins.
Later source objects overwrite earlier ones. custom comes after defaults, so its speed wins.
An object with the speed value from custom
Correct! Properties from later sources overwrite earlier ones, so custom.speed replaces defaults.speed.
Correct! Properties from later sources overwrite earlier ones, so custom.speed replaces defaults.speed.
An object with both speed values stored in an array
Object.assign overwrites properties with the same key. It does not merge them into arrays.
Object.assign overwrites properties with the same key. It does not merge them into arrays.
A TypeError because of duplicate property names
Duplicate keys are expected. Object.assign simply overwrites earlier values with later ones.
Duplicate keys are expected. Object.assign simply overwrites earlier values with later ones.
